GECC.scope: Yelp is not in the paper; this applies the documented large-dataset search to a new dataset

GC4NC.scope: Downstream GCN search, not condensation algorithm hyperparameters

code_evidence.synthetic_alignment_gradient: SimGC_transductive.py:234-238; SimGC_inductive.py:226-230: synthetic propagation is not detached
code_evidence.smoothness_sign: SimGC_transductive.py:228; SimGC_inductive.py:222: negative weighted mean RBF similarity; paper Eq. 6 writes positive similarity, so the port follows released code here
code_evidence.citation_teacher: SimGC_transductive.py:397: nonlinear SGC, hidden 2048, no dropout/BN, two propagation hops
code_evidence.teacher_lr_epochs: SimGC_transductive.py defaults: lr=0.001,1000 iterations; scripts/ogbn_arxiv.sh does not override the teacher learning rate. SimGC_inductive.py defaults: lr=0.01,600 iterations
code_evidence.teacher_weight_decay: train_teacher() in both original programs constructs Adam with lr only, hence weight_decay=0. The port must not inherit downstream GCN weight decay.
code_evidence.citation_validation: SimGC_transductive.py:180: GCN hidden 2048, act=None, dropout=0, norm=None. Adam lr=0.001, weight_decay=0; range(student_model_loop=3000), validation every 100; condensation checkpoints every 100.
code_evidence.citation_final: SimGC_transductive.py:453: GCN hidden 1024, act=None, dropout=0, norm=None. Final range(student_model_loop+1) performs 3001 updates; intermediate performs 3000. Teacher range(teacher_model_loop+1) performs 1001 updates, validation every 50.
code_evidence.citation_initialization: models/convs/gcn_conv.py:139-151: Glorot weight initialization and zero biases. SGC_Multi uses PyG Linear in the MLP. The port now keeps these citation defaults separate from other methods.
code_evidence.activation_bug: BaseGNN previously hardcoded with_relu=True and ignored args.activation. The package now honors None/none/linear and supported activations in dense and sampled forward paths.
code_evidence.search_baseline: Future citation searches include the released hidden-1024 baseline alongside the 108 GC4NC parameter combinations; graph selection independently retains author hidden-2048 validation. Old manifests keep their original candidate IDs and source snapshots.
code_evidence.citation_features: utils.py:66-80 sets NormalizeFeatures on dataset.transform, but Pyg2Dpr reads dataset.data at line 97 instead of dataset[0]. Thus the released Cora/Citeseer converter receives raw, unnormalized features. Citation configs now set pre_norm=false explicitly to match effective author inputs, not the unused transform flag. Other method defaults are unchanged.
code_evidence.synthetic_class_counts: SimGC_transductive.py:81-95 allocates ceil(class_training_count * reduction_rate) per class. SimGC now uses this author rule rather than the generic floor-based total budget; other methods retain their allocation rules.

SimGC.scope: No condensation search grid is specified. Pubmed and Yelp are not paper datasets: use common transductive/inductive defaults and mark as extensions. Downstream tuning uses GC4NC Table 11.
